def diff_summary():
    bt = last_transition.before_frame.ascii.split('\n'); at = last_transition.after_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    g = {}
    for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(bt,at)):
        for j,(xc,yc) in enumerate(zip(x,y)):

    out=[]
    for k,v in g.items():
        rs=[p[0] for p in v]; cs=[p[1] for p in v]
        out.append(f"{k} r{min(rs)}-{max(rs)} c{min(cs)}-{max(cs)} n{len(v)}")
    return out

def diff_summary():
    bt = last_transition.before_frame.ascii.split('\n'); at = last_transition.after_frame.ascii.split('\n')
